{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Unique values in customer_age:", df['customer_age'].unique())
print("Count of -1 values in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue column
print("First 5 values of revenue:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Check for QA orders
print("Rows with revenue == 999999.99:", df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0])

# Check for refunded orders
print("Status distribution:", df['status'].value_counts())"}
